name: object_occupancy
verifies: fix-66: one user per interactive object as in G3 (gCInteraction_PS.User): the hero cannot use the Faring anvil Zakosh works at (it is not even focused); once Zakosh leaves for the evening the hero takes it and holds it, and lets go when the page closes. A campfire is shared: at Ardea the hero fries meat at the fire the freed slaves sit around.
steps: log fix-72 (R35-1): the anvil lies in the Faring castle courtyard (zone a4de440f, security Enclave): without Faring enclave fame 75 the hero is an intruder (warn 0/4 s, attack 8 s, the town joins); safe gives only Orc political fame
log fix-67 (R33-3): the Faring rebel smith shares this anvil point but his sector is off until the liberation: he holds nothing
log evening: Zakosh leaves his anvil (relax phase), the anvil is free
notes: objusers:<object> = the user of each use pose of the nearest such object ('-' = free), userefusal:<object> = why the hero's use would be refused ('occupied', 'in combat', 'no view' …) or 'ok'. The Ardea fire's sitters use their own SitCampfire points around it (G3: separate entities), so the hero never waits for them; the six Campfire objects that are NPC routine points take one NPC per pose and the hero joins even when both are taken.
